**Risk flags:**
- Gemilang Holdings Sdn. Bhd. holds 51.0% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Cahaya Harmoni Hotel Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited boutique hotel operating in Kota Kinabalu, registered in Kedah. Incorporated on 17 Oct 1995, the firm has a share capital of RM 1,000,000 and is owned 51 % by Gemilang Holdings Sdn. Bhd. with two directors on the board. Financially, revenue grew from RM 8,987,761 in 2022 to RM 16,436,671 in 2024, with profit after tax rising from RM 465,234 to RM 975,406 over the same period. Current ratios fell from 2.64 to 1.63, while interest coverage remained above 4× and audit opinions were unqualified. No legal cases are recorded.
